description: Build the shared visual + interaction foundation for the redesign: (a) rewrite style.css to a strictly black-and-white (monochrome) elegant theme, and (b) add reusable vanilla-JS UI helpers to api.js/nav.js for generating self-contained monochrome book cover images, showing toast/inline feedback, and a reusable confirmation dialog. These shared pieces are consumed by every page in FEAT-003, so this feature must land first. Keep everything plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS - no framework, bundler, or npm packages. Do NOT change backend contracts or any Api.* method signatures; only ADD helpers.
steps: Rewrite frontend/assets/css/style.css to a strictly monochrome (black, white, and grayscale ONLY) theme. Replace every colored CSS variable in :root (currently blue --color-primary #2563eb, sky accents, green success, red danger, amber warning) with grayscale equivalents: e.g. --color-text #111 / near-black, --color-bg #fff, backgrounds/borders/muted in shades of gray (#f5f5f5, #e5e5e5, #d4d4d4, #666, #999). Remove all blue/green/red/amber hues. Success/error/warning/badge states must be distinguished by grayscale shade, border weight, and/or typography (not hue) - e.g. error = dark border + bold text, success = light-gray fill. Keep the existing class names and structure so the HTML pages keep working (navbar, auth-card, book-grid, book-card, btn/btn-primary/btn-outline/btn-danger/btn-sm, alert/alert-error/alert-success, table, badge*, tabs, modal-overlay/modal, empty-state, utilities). btn-primary should be solid black on white text; btn-outline black border on white; btn-danger a clearly-distinct dark/bordered treatment - all monochrome. Ensure strong contrast, clean typography, generous spacing, subtle grayscale borders/shadows, and a card-based book grid. Keep the responsive @media rules.
Add styles for a book cover IMAGE inside .book-card. Repurpose/extend the existing `.book-cover` rule so it renders an /

Add a small reusable confirmation-dialog CSS block if not already covered by .modal-overlay/.modal: a `.confirm-dialog` variant (or reuse .modal) with a title, message, and two actions (confirm/cancel). Also add a `.toast`/`.toast-container` style for transient feedback messages (monochrome: dark background, white text, or white card with dark border), positioned fixed (e.g. bottom-right), with a subtle fade. Keep it optional/additive - existing .alert styles must remain.

In frontend/assets/js/api.js, ADD (do not modify existing Auth/Api/apiRequest) a small set of exported globals used across pages: (1) `function bookCoverSvg(book)` that returns a self-contained data-URI (data:image/svg+xml,...) for an inline SVG monochrome book cover generated deterministically from the book (title + author). The SVG must be black/white/gray only: e.g. a dark rectangle with the book's initials or title text and author in white/gray, sized for a cover. It must not require any network access. This satisfies 'every book must display a cover image' with no backend change. (2) A `UI` helper object (or standalone functions) exposing `UI.toast(message, type)` where type is 'success'|'error' rendered in grayscale, and `UI.confirm({title, message, confirmText, cancelText})` returning a Promise<boolean> that shows a monochrome confirmation dialog/modal and resolves true only when the user clicks confirm. Implement UI.confirm by injecting a .modal-overlay/.confirm-dialog element into document.body (create a container lazily) so it works on every page without extra HTML. If injecting DOM from api.js is awkward, place UI in nav.js instead - but it MUST be available on pages that do not include nav.js (login/register) too if needed; since only index/my-loans/admin need confirm, prefer defining bookCoverSvg + UI in api.js so all pages can use them. escapeHtml() currently lives in nav.js and is used by nav.js; if UI helpers need escaping and live in api.js, add a local escape utility there rather than depending on nav.js load order.
Verify `node --check frontend/assets/js/api.js` and `node --check frontend/assets/js/nav.js` still pass after edits.
Record in findings: the exact names/signatures of the new helpers (bookCoverSvg, UI.toast, UI.confirm) and where they live, so FEAT-003 can wire them into the pages.
acceptance_criteria: style.css contains NO colored hex values or named colors outside black/white/gray (no blue #2563eb/#1d4ed8/#60a5fa, no green #16a34a, no red #dc2626, no amber #d97706, etc.); all --color-* variables and rules are grayscale.
`.book-cover img`/svg styling renders covers as grayscale, object-fit cover, within the card.

api.js exposes a working `bookCoverSvg(book)` returning a self-contained data-URI SVG (no network), and `UI.toast` + `UI.confirm` (Promise-returning) helpers, without altering existing Auth/Api/apiRequest signatures or method names.
findings lists the new helper names/signatures and their file locations.
verification: grep -nEi '#2563eb|#1d4ed8|#60a5fa|#38bdf8|#16a34a|#dc2626|#d97706|rgba\\(37' frontend/assets/css/style.css || echo 'no colored values remain'
findings: COMPLETED on branch main. Shared foundation for the monochrome redesign is in place; FEAT-003 can now wire these into the HTML pages. CSS (frontend/assets/css/style.css): fully rewritten to strictly black/white/grayscale. Only hex values present are #000000 #111111 #333333 #666666 #e5e5e5 #f0f0f0 #f5f5f5 #fafafa #ffffff (verified via grep). All class names/structure preserved (navbar, auth-card, book-grid, book-card, btn/btn-primary/btn-outline/btn-danger/btn-sm, alert*, table, badge*, tabs, modal-overlay/modal, empty-state, utilities). New/changed rules: btn-primary=solid black bg+white text; btn-outline=black border on white; btn-danger=white bg + 2px black border + underline, inverts to black-on-hover (distinct monochrome treatment). State differentiation is by shade/border-weight/typography not hue (alert-error=2px black border+bold; alert-success=light-gray fill; badge-borrowed=bold black border; stock-badge.available=solid black). ADDED cover image styling: .book-cover is now a 180px-tall top-of-card block and `.book-cover img, .book-cover svg { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; filter:grayscale(1); display:block; }`. ADDED additive `.confirm-dialog` (used inside .modal-overlay) and `.toast-container`/`.toast`/`.toast.toast-success`/`.toast.toast-error` styles (fixed bottom-right, fade transition). Existing .alert styles retained. Responsive @media (max-width:640px) kept and extended for toasts. JS (frontend/assets/js/api.js) - ADDED at end of file, NO changes to Auth/Api/apiRequest: - `function escapeHtmlAttr(str) -> string` : local HTML-escape (so helpers work on login/register which do NOT load nav.js). Does not touch nav.js's global escapeHtml(). - `function bookCoverSvg(book) -> string` : returns a self-contained `data:image/svg+xml,` URI (no network). Deterministic 300x420 portrait cover from book.title + book.author: dark grayscale bg (equal-channel rgb), white initials (up to 2), white title, gray author. Use as an or set on .book-cover. Book shape used: {title, author} (id optional, unused). Verified: valid data-URI, well-formed
